scene: Test-only panorama hook supplies a solid background, 256-color spectrum and original Button before native blur. ConfirmScreen, Screen and the original GPU post-effect render the actual target. Panoramas and worlds are context supplied, not reconstructed here.

blur.sampling: bilinear shader pair taps plus final half-weight tap

shade: Original menu_background.png and inworld_menu_background.png are uniform black RGBA(0,0,0,64).

browserBackdrop.implementation: Local DOM-to-canvas snapshot via modern-screenshot4.7.0; original oversized triangle, six bilinear box passes in RGBA8 and source-alpha menu shading in WebGL.
browserBackdrop.verification: 150 full-viewport zero-tolerance pixel cases; background changes and fixed UI during page scroll also compared to original references.
browserBackdrop.knownLimitations: SVG/foreignObject snapshots render vector font antialiasing as grayscale rather than Windows LCD subpixels; exact background proof covers the declared bitmap UI scenes. Other vector/video/cross-origin underlays are unverified.
browserBackdrop.firstFrame: SVG convolution is an approximate initial frame; settled pixel verification requires data-mc-confirmation-gpu-ready=true.
